McpServerDefinition.description: Account briefs for one Salesforce account, as the signed-in user: resolve the account, then brief it, or ask the Account Brief agent.

tools.descriptionOverride: Find one Salesforce account from its name, part of its name, or an account Id. Returns RESOLVED with the account Id, AMBIGUOUS with candidates to choose from, or NOT_FOUND. Call this first; get_account_brief needs the Id it returns.
Ask the Account Brief agent in plain language: a brief on one account, or a question about the CRM data the signed-in user can see. The agent finds the account itself and answers in prose.

Write a brief on one account, given an account Id that resolve_account returned as RESOLVED. Covers profile, open deals, cases, contacts and recent activity, as the signed-in user can see them. Optionally pass the question as asked, or the sections wanted.
